video.decoding_capability: Live view: 1CH 16MP@30 / 4CH 12MP (main output only); playback: 1CH 16MP@30 / 4CH 8MP (main output only)

features: When HDMI1 outputs 8K, HDMI2 is unavailable
Face detection: 128CH (AI by IPC), 4CH 4MP (AI by device); 36 pictures/second, 10000 face pictures
Human/vehicle classification: up to 128CH (AI by IPC), 8CH 2MP (AI by device); human/vehicle attribute analysis
Plate recognition (AI by IPC): up to 128CH
Smart analytics including AI by ONVIF
Second network interface for connecting cameras via a switch on a closed network
eSATA: record only, single drive each, up to 26TB
notes: Spec sheet feature list gives 6 facial recognition channels in total; the spec table gives 16CH. Facial recognition channel count left out.
